launcher.notes: KINETRIX LAUNCHER 3.0.3 - TASKBAR ICON FIXED, NO MORE WHITE TILE. Windows players saw the correct Kinetrix logo on the desktop shortcut but a blank WHITE icon on the taskbar once the launcher was open. Reason: the desktop shortcut renders straight from the icon embedded in the exe, while the running window's taskbar button was given a single 256px PNG - Windows wants a real multi-size .ico (16/24/32/48px frames) for that small taskbar image, and with a PNG it silently falls back to a white tile. The launcher window now uses the full multi-size Kinetrix .ico (shipped inside the app), the app identity (AppUserModelID) is registered before any window exists so the taskbar always associates the button with the installed launcher, and the icon is re-asserted right before the window shows as insurance for frameless windows. Linux is unchanged and v3.0.2's bundled Linux game libraries carry over untouched. Everything else stands: all Minecraft versions with Forge or Fabric, Modrinth + CurseForge mod browser, Modrinth profile import, Microsoft sign-in, cosmetics locker, crash doctor and auto-update.

notes: Kinetrix Client 3.14.0 - LOCKER SECURITY FIX + SKINS WITHOUT LOGIN + CELESTIAL COLLECTION + HD CAPES. Security: a cosmetics session whose Minecraft username changed is now signed out immediately - renaming in the Account Manager can never show another player's locker (you are asked to sign in again). Skins: your skin is fetched straight from the Kinetrix database by your username and shown even when you never sign in to cosmetics - boot, world join, Locker preview and the Skins screen; only uploading/cloud sync still needs an account. New Celestial Collection: 12 new 48-frame animated capes (Eclipse, Zenith, Celestial, Quantum, Mirage, Sapphire, Emerald Dream, Crimson King, Hyperspace, Northern Lights, Solstice, Obsidian) + 4 new auras (Gold, Obsidian, Nebula, Aurora) - the Locker now holds 117 cosmetics. HD capes: every cape re-rendered at 1024x512 with 48-frame loops, crisp on 4K, with a lazy frame loader that keeps your FPS untouched. NOTE: this update is ~102 MB because of the HD cape art - one-time download.
